verdict.rationale: Supabase documents self-hosting directly: it deploys within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose, it is positioned for full data control and isolated environments, and the open-source repo backs it. The CLI also runs the entire stack locally. Missing for 10: detail on feature parity and operations for self-hosted deployments (which services ship, upgrades, Studio and auth configuration), and independent hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting beyond local-dev anecdotes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy Supabase within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose.
Self-hosting is a good fit if you need full control over your data, have compliance requirements that prevent you from using managed services, or want to run Supabase in an isolated environment.
We're building the features of Firebase using enterprise-grade open source tools.
The Supabase CLI enables you to run the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.
